# pve_replication_job (Resource)

Storage replication job between two nodes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_replication_job" "example" {
  item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
  target  = "CHANGE_ME"
  type    = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) Replication Job ID. The ID is composed of a Guest ID and a job number, separated by a hyphen, i.e. '<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>'.
- `target` (String) Target node.
- `type` (String) Section type. One of: `local`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Description.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Flag to disable/deactivate the entry.
- `force` (Boolean) Will remove the jobconfig entry, but will not cleanup. (default: 0)
- `keep` (Boolean) Keep replicated data at target (do not remove). (default: 0)
- `rate` (Number) Rate limit in mbps (megabytes per second) as floating point number.
- `remove_job` (String) Mark the replication job for removal. The job will remove all local replication snapshots. When set to 'full', it also tries to remove replicated volumes on the target. The job then removes itself from the configuration file. One of: `local`, `full`.
- `schedule` (String) Storage replication schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events. (default: */15)
- `source` (String) For internal use, to detect if the guest was stolen.

### Read-Only

- `api_id` (String) Replication Job ID. The ID is composed of a Guest ID and a job number, separated by a hyphen, i.e. '<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>'.
- `guest` (Number) Guest ID.
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
- `jobnum` (Number) Unique, sequential ID assigned to each job.
